program: GLHS R4 — Governed Read-to-Write Continuity (GRWC) / Exact-Disclosure Admission

prohibited_substitutions: Simulated in-memory storage must not be reported as PostgreSQL
Synthetic mocks must not be reported as real provider LLM executions

verification_rules: Strict chronological precedence: freeze_timestamp_utc < execution_started_utc <= execution_completed_utc <= validated_at_utc <= sealed_at_utc
Every relative path in checksums.sha256 must exist and match calculated SHA-256 hex digest
seal.json must be generated inside the artifact directory with full artifact_inventory hash map
Zero unhandled exceptions or safety invariant breaches allowed in claim-eligible runs
Two-digest binding (H_proj + H_env) must independently verify projection and transport integrity

E17.name: Current-State Insufficiency Witness Protocol

E18.name: Global Source Support vs. Disclosed Support Separation Protocol

E19.name: Transport Serialization Attack Resistance Protocol

E20.name: Optional Provider Verifiable Receipt Attestation Study
